title: Database criteria route through the shared comparison helper; lib tests only, no live rows
status_plain: The database family reaches the same 15-significant-digit truncation helper as the criteria family (database_family.rs:8 imports compare_excel_numbers, used at :375). But the BUG-FUNC-004 sign-off does NOT include DCOUNT or DSUM among its 16 live lanes. The source disclaims them in the same breath as the figure: they "pass their lib tests", i.e. internal Rust regression tests, not a live-Excel comparison, and the source asks for a row to be re-added "only on a fresh witness". Live DCOUNT/DSUM observations do exist, but only in the 2026-04-08 pre-fix intake list, with no build restated for that date. There is no counted DCOUNT or DSUM comparison against Excel.
open_question: No fresh live-Excel witness for DCOUNT or DSUM exists.
reader_warning: Do not let DCOUNT or DSUM borrow the 16/16. The source excludes them from the live lanes explicitly and rests them on internal unit tests.
